title: Do Weighted Blankets Have Health Benefits?
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: From VOA Learning English, this is the Health & Lifestyle report.
sentences.zh: 从VOA学习英语, 这是健康和生活方式报告。

sentences.en: When her husband gave her a weighted blanket to help her sleep, Rhonda James did not think it would work.
sentences.zh: 当她的丈夫给了她一个加权的毯子帮助她睡觉时,Rhonda James认为这行不通。

sentences.en: In other words, she was skeptical. But five minutes after covering herself with the blanket, she was asleep.
sentences.zh: 换句话说,她怀疑,但用毯子遮住5分钟后,她睡着了。

sentences.en: “It felt like a really big hug ,” said James.
sentences.zh: James说,“感觉就像一个很大的拥抱,”

sentences.en: She is a banker who lives in Charleston, South Carolina.
sentences.zh: 她是住在南卡罗来纳州查尔斯顿的银行家

sentences.en: As temperatures drop, a weighted blanket can be a popular choice to help you keep warm.
sentences.zh: 随着温度的下降, 加权毯子可以是一个流行的选择 帮助你保持温暖。

sentences.en: But some people say the extra pressure of the cover also helps to ease their worries and fall asleep faster.
sentences.zh: 但有些人说 外加的外加压力 也有助于缓解他们的担心 并睡得更快。

sentences.en: However, research on the effectiveness of weighted blankets is limited.
sentences.zh: 然而,关于加权毯子效力的研究有限。

sentences.en: The Associated Press recently reported on what is known about weighted blankets.
sentences.zh: 美联社最近报告了关于加权毯子的已知情况。

sentences.en: First, what is a weighted blanket? Weighted blankets are filled with small glass balls, cotton or another filling.
sentences.zh: 首先,什么是加权毯子?重毛毯装满了小玻璃球、棉花或其他填充物。

sentences.en: This makes them heavier than usual blankets.
sentences.zh: 这使得它们比平时的毯子更重

sentences.en: Scientists may not know exactly how the blankets comfort , but they have a few ideas.
sentences.zh: 科学家也许不知道毯子是如何舒适的,

sentences.en: The heavy, even feeling from a weighted blanket may calm the brain’s fight-or-flight response , said Dr.
sentences.zh: 可能让大脑的战斗或飞行反应平静下来。

sentences.en: Neal Walia. He is a sleep medicine expert at University of California, Los Angeles Health.
sentences.zh: Neal Walia 他是加州大学的睡眠医学专家 洛杉矶卫生局

sentences.en: He said, “The evenly distributed weight on you tells your body..." you are in a "...calm environment.’” The extra pressure also may cause the brain to release the hormone oxytocin.
sentences.zh: 他说,“你身上平均分布的重量告诉了你身体......你处在一个“...热环境 ” 。 额外的压力也可能导致大脑释放荷尔蒙催产素。

sentences.en: Sometimes called the “love hormone,” the body creates oxytocin during loving moments, such as hugging.
sentences.zh: 有时被称为“爱荷尔蒙”,

sentences.en: Oxytocin can also lower anxiety , Walia said.
sentences.zh: 瓦莉亚说,

sentences.en: How do you use a weighted blanket? For most healthy adults, experts say to choose a blanket that is about 10 percent of your body weight.
sentences.zh: 如何使用加权毯子?对于大多数健康的成年人,专家说要选择大约占身体重量10%的毯子。

sentences.en: However, the blankets are not good for everyone.
sentences.zh: 但是,毯子对每个人都不好。

sentences.en: For example, some people may find them too hot to use, especially during warmer weather.
sentences.zh: 例如,有些人可能发现它们太热,无法使用,特别是在天气变暖时。

sentences.en: People with breathing problems or disorders such as sleep apnea should check with a doctor before using a weighted blanket.
sentences.zh: 呼吸有问题或患有睡眠性催眠等疾病的人,在使用加权毯子之前,应与医生核对。

sentences.en: Experts say to not use weighted blankets for children under three years old.
sentences.zh: 专家说,三岁以下儿童不使用加权毯子。

sentences.en: The weight can limit their movement and breathing.
sentences.zh: 重量可以限制他们的行动和呼吸。

sentences.en: Some people may not be able to buy them.
sentences.zh: 有些人可能买不到。

sentences.en: They can be costly. A quality weighted blankets can cost between $50 to over $300.
sentences.zh: 质量加权的毯子成本在50到300美元之间。

sentences.en: This depends on the size, weight and material.
sentences.zh: 这取决于大小、重量和材料。

sentences.en: Some people use them for other reasons than sleep.
sentences.zh: 有些人出于睡眠以外的原因使用它们。

sentences.en: Rhonda James gets under her blanket to relax as she watches television or drinks a glass of wine.
sentences.zh: Rhonda James在她看电视或喝杯酒时 躺在毯子下放松

sentences.en: Lucy Taylor, a writer from Wales, also uses a weighted blanket.
sentences.zh: 来自威尔士的作家Lucy Taylor 也使用加权毯子

sentences.en: Her anxiety increases during the winter.
sentences.zh: 她的焦虑在冬天加剧

sentences.en: So, she uses her blanket during cold months to fall asleep.
sentences.zh: 所以在寒冷的几个月里 她用毯子睡着

sentences.en: She says when her body is relaxed, her mind relaxes too.
sentences.zh: 她说,当她的身体放松, 她的头脑也放松。

sentences.en: Can weighted blankets improve sleep? There is little scientific research on whether weighted blankets help with sleep, anxiety, or other health issues.
sentences.zh: 加权毯子能改善睡眠吗? 有关加权毯子是否有助于睡眠、焦虑或其他健康问题的科学研究很少。

sentences.en: The studies that exist involve small groups of people.
sentences.zh: 现有的研究涉及少数人群。

sentences.en: And most of the study subjects are people with conditions including sleep problems, long-term pain, and mental and developmental disorders.
sentences.zh: 大部分的学习科目是 患有睡眠问题, 长期疼痛, 精神和发育障碍的人。

sentences.en: A study on 120 people with insomnia, an inability to get enough sleep, found that the weighted blankets helped them sleep better compared to a light blanket.
sentences.zh: 研究120名失眠者 无法入睡 发现加权毯子比轻毯子 帮助他们睡得更好

sentences.en: Another study considered 67 children with the developmental and brain disorder autism .
sentences.zh: 另一项研究认为,67名儿童患有发育障碍和大脑自闭症。

sentences.en: That research found that weighted blankets did not affect the children’s sleep at all.
sentences.zh: 研究发现,加权毯子根本不影响儿童的睡眠。

sentences.en: However, it also found that the study subjects liked the weighted blankets more than non-weighted blankets.
sentences.zh: 然而,它也发现,研究对象更喜欢加权毯子,而不是非加权毯子。

sentences.en: A third study on 94 adults with chronic pain found that a heavier weighted blanket did not affect sleep.
sentences.zh: 第三项关于有慢性疼痛的94名成年人的研究发现,较重的加权毯子并不影响睡眠。

sentences.en: But it was better at reducing pain than a lighter blanket.
sentences.zh: 但比起一个轻薄的毯子 更能减轻痛苦

sentences.en: So, there is not much scientific evidence to support health improvement claims about weighted blankets.
sentences.zh: 因此,没有多少科学证据支持关于加权毯子的改善健康索赔。

sentences.en: However, in most cases they also cannot hurt, sleep experts say.
sentences.zh: 然而,在多数情况下,他们也不能受到伤害,睡眠专家说。

sentences.en: Dr. Daniel Barone is a sleep medicine expert at Weill Cornell Medicine in New York City.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔·巴隆博士是纽约市Weill Cornell医学的睡眠医学专家

sentences.en: He suggests the use of weighted blankets to his patients after they try other traditional treatments and medicines.
sentences.zh: 他建议病人在尝试其他传统治疗和药物后使用加权毯子。

sentences.en: “If it doesn’t hurt and it may help, it’s worth a shot,” he said.
sentences.zh: 他说:「如果它不痛, 可能有用,

sentences.en: And that’s the Health & Lifestyle report.
sentences.zh: 这是《健康与生活方式报告》。

sentences.en: I’m Anna Matteo. Adithi Ramakrishnan reported this story for The Associated Press.
sentences.zh: 我是Anna Matteo, Adithi Ramakrishnan为美联社报导这个故事。

sentences.en: Anna Matteo adapted it for VOA Learning English.
sentences.zh: Anna Matteo改编成VOA英文学习版。
